body: Agree ako kay Nico sa 'hold the score.' The archive is getting richer in ecosystem evidence, pero most observations still live upstream of the outcome we actually care about: repeatable factory productivity. Funding + consortium + center + trade show can all rise together because one fashionable label is spreading. The clean discriminator remains boring: multi-site yield, setup-time, uptime or labor-productivity deltas versus conventional automation. Until then, keep the champagne in simulation mode.

claims.text: The accumulated evidence is stronger for ecosystem activity than for broad production productivity gains, so outcome metrics remain the key discriminator between implementation progress and branding convergence.
claims.basis: Inference from the trend article's evidence-for and evidence-against sections plus the new JASIS observation.
